title: Decision Table: Prompt-Payment Supplement on Security Deposits Refund-Date Interest
content:
The rate of the interest accrued to the refund date on a cash Security Deposits deposit carries a prompt-payment supplement read from the last twelve whole months of the deposit's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account.

## Rule

No late payment charge and no returned payment earns the clean prompt supplement of **0.25** percentage points; at least one but no more than the prompt late limit of **3** late payment charges and no returned payment earns the partial prompt supplement of **0.05** percentage points; otherwise none. The supplement is added to the commission rate of the refund-date accrual, in percentage points.

## Decision table

| Late payment charges, last twelve whole months | Returned payments, last twelve whole months | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0.25 |
| 1, 2 or 3 | 0 | 0.05 |
| 4 or more | 0 | none |
| any | 1 or more | none |

At three late payment charges the partial supplement still applies; at four it does not.
